name: Yoga Movement Hong Kong

brand_voice.summary: Same warm, inclusive, community-first voice as Yoga Movement Singapore, localised for Hong Kong. Lower-commitment entry offers dominate, so copy often reduces friction for first-timers ("no commitment needed", "try YM without overthinking it").
signature_phrases: Yoga that meets you where you are
Find your flow, find your people
Bring a friend, bring a few, or bring the whole crew
rules: Always write prices as HK$ (e.g. HK$380), never plain $.
Reference Hong Kong where it helps local relevance ("Get Moving In Hong Kong").
Practical reassurances work well for newcomers: mats, towels and showers are provided.
The branded merch is written "YM MVMT Kit".
Class packs are shareable with unlimited friends.
avoid: Implying the viewer is inflexible, unfit or stressed (Meta personal attributes policy)
